notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 - Out Now for Nice Day for Fishing!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey there adventurers! 👋[/b]

We're back again with another patch for Nice Day for Fishing on Steam 🤝 

Let us [b]introduce you to Patch 1.1.0, which brings more improvements, bug fixes and the well requested addition of Portals across Azerim![/b]

[/p][h2]Portals in Azerim 🌀[/h2][p][b]Patch 1.1.0 is out now on Steam and one major addition in this update is Buildable Teleport Portals.[/b] There are four of these Portals, which you guessed it- you must build to use!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300978/72d5fd777088cf480ede9f453fe5ae92136ca6fe.png"][/img][/p][p][b]🏠 2 in Honeywood
⛱️ 1 at the Beach of Azerim
⚒️ 1 at the Undead Mines[/b]

These Portals allow for faster travel across the map, with the portals requiring you to dredge out some of the finest materials in our fishing game with your magnet hook.

We estimate that you'll be able to start unlocking these Portals in the last third of the game!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300978/e9fc2a0a448735ad7a95091c798f51fb11c1d9e3.png"][/img][/p][p]Also, if you've dredged up the Tinfoil Hat, the Ring of Mordor or the Company Property Necklace from our Legendary DLC, you'll want to re-equip them for a surprise we've added in this patch... 👀

We hope you enjoy this and the many other additions, tweaks and fixes that 1.1.0 has to offer... and [b]remember to shout 'Portal AWAYYYYY' as you enter those Portals[/b], adventurers! 😄 [/p][p][/p][h2]Please find our full Patch Notes for Patch 1.1.0 below:[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300978/d289de523e9784259174bdd5352d68753e4b73e8.png"][/img][/p][h2]Patch 1.1.0 - Patch Notes[/h2][h3][b]Additions[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added four Teleport Portals:[/p][list][*][p]Two in the Town of Honeywood.[/p][/*][*][p]One at the Beach of Azerim.[/p][/*][*][p]One at the Undead Mines.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added new inventory tabs and order.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the option to view baits in your inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new sounds for when collecting and equipping some Legendary DLC items.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Changes & Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Changes to the levelling up system, which players now shown their multiple levels ups when getting more exp than needed.[/p][/*][*][p]Changes to the inventory slider when player has more than 25 items.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the stacking of status effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to performance when collecting items.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements and adjustments to the Icon for the shift button.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with the currents at the anchovy fish cave.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a save issue during the dark water scene.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues around saving whilst in cutscenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Bodger's Hammer would occasionally be missing when saving at the Hammer X quest.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the spawn position for the Wolf Fish to prevent it hanging on corners.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue around interaction speech indicators, which would occasionally remain incorrectly active.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Baradun would occasionally be missing on a broken quest line when saving and quitting after getting the Holy Garlic.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Player Support[/h3][p]If you run into any issues with Nice Day for Fishing, please [url="https://team17.helpshift.com/hc/en/3-team17/contact-us/"]get in touch with our Support Team here![/url]

notes.title: Nice Day for Fishing 🎣 Launch Month Dev Log!
notes.content:
[b]Hello adventurers! 👋[/b]

We want to thank you all for your support on our Demo Update 1.0 and our recent Release Date Announcement at CAGGTUS 2025!

Today, we wanted to cover some topics we've seen discussed in the community and talk more about the full launch of our game set in the Epic NPC Man world! 🌏

[h3]Approaching May 29th! 🎣[/h3]

Everyone working on Nice Day for Fishing is getting more and more excited, the closer we get to our release day! Our small development team at FusionPlay have dedicated four years of our lives to bring the Epic NPC Man Universe to life through Nice Day for Fishing. We're so excited to see which of the many references to the Viva La Dirt League's world and the Epic NPC Man series you will find throughout the game and how much time you'll all spend fishing as Baelin!

It's been amazing seeing that excitement reflected in the community after your super-positive demo update feedback. We can't wait to see how players around the world experience our fishing-adventure game on launch day!

[h3]Rebuilding Honeywood ⚒️[/h3]

One game mechanic that you are yet to explore and features in the content past the demo, is resource gathering and town restoration. As you'll experience in the demo,[spoiler]Honeywood is destroyed at the start of the game and it's Baelin's job to rebuild the town[/spoiler].

Players find unique resources in each of the 12 underwater regions, dredging them with the magnet hook. These resources can then be used to upgrade the houses across Honeywood, with each upgrade unlocking new shop inventory (and more! 👀) for each building in the town!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300978/2ebdc07461918c641fbf27143a2c781a6964cebc.png[/img]
As you upgrade Honeywood, you'll gain access to better fishing rods, new rings, hats and necklaces... alongside more challenging side-quests from the mayor. Yes, you read that right! There is a mayor of Honeywood, who gives out extremely dangerous quests like... collecting 10 oysters. Dangerous oysters with sharp edges! Who knows, you might accidentally step on them.

Overall, by gathering enough resources from across the land and upgrading the houses, Honeywood will become a beautiful town once again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300978/73e69b30e82116b7046c2b6d24e2bfff6c8f1ed2.png[/img]
[h3]Character Sound Bites 🗣️[/h3]

Nice Day for Fishing includes character voice line sound bites when interacting with characters from Viva La Dirt League’s Epic NPC Man universe! We also wanted to clarify that there are no plans for the game to be full voice acted, however the latest Demo Update added new voice line sound bites!

At the very early stages of development we wanted to hear the voices of Greg, Bodger, and of course Baelin in the game. After FusionPlay's meetings with Viva La Dirt League during this time, we decided together to go down the old-school RPG route of having the most common catchphrases from each character in Nice Day for Fishing. In the end, that's always what we wanted to make: [b]An old school retro RPG, set in the world of Azerim with a fishy twist![/b]

We then were super happy that we could incorporate even more voice lines for the game, adding catchphrases for Willow, Fred, Freda and Charles. We even created voiced for the new characters in The Goblin, Thidon and the Murgol!

As development progressed, we added more voice lines in the game for the existing characters, which became more "rare" voice lines! We find it particularly funny when Baradun sometimes greets you as "Peasant?" instead of his usually "Hello Adventurer!". We can't wait for you to hear all of the characters voice lines and find the rare voice lines too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300978/ee8882bceec14cf1fd97b2a8b1ea6667a9935622.png[/img]
[h3]Button Remapping ⌨️[/h3]

We’ve also seen your comments around button remapping on Steam whilst playing our demo. Although this is something we’d like to implement, button remapping isn’t currently on the cards for Nice Day for Fishing, as it would require a full revamp of the coding behind the controls of our game.

We may look to add this to the game in the future, but at this time, we cannot guarantee it will be added to Nice Day for Fishing. 

All of our focus over the recent months has been around integrating new features to our fishing RPG adventure game and delivering you the best game come launch day on May 29th!

[h2]Play the demo today: 👇[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393160/Nice_Day_for_Fishing/

Make sure to follow our X social media channel below, as we have some news coming your way next week!

We hope you're excited for our launch on May 29th... Portal AWAYYYYY! 🌀

notes.title: Demo Update 1.0 - OUT NOW! 🎣 Our demo is back on Steam with improvements!
notes.content:
[h3]Nice Day for a Demo update, ain't it? 😏[/h3]

Our Nice Day for Fishing Demo is back on Steam with a big update... [b]Adventurer, we hope you accept this quest to explore Honeywood in Demo Update 1.0![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300978/b8723a046ac923646d286a57a3f94f4847f76a26.png[/img]

Your overwhelming support during Steam Next Fest and beyond has been incredible! From your feedback around our first demo build, we've implemented changes, improvements and additions to make you have the best adventure possible as Baelin in our demo! 🎣

We'd also like to highlight one major addition, as we've added new localised languages to the demo. The demo now includes German, French, Spanish, and Simplified Chinese languages! 

Please read our patch notes below for a full list of demo additions, changes and improvements:

[h2]⚙️ Patch Notes Demo 1.10 ⚙️[/h2]
[h3]Additions[/h3]
[b]New Languages[/b]
[list][*] Added German, French, Spanish, and Simplified Chinese languages.[/list] [b]All Additions[/b][list][*] Added permanent attacking when holding the attack button.
[*] Added new voice line sound bites for all NPCs.
[*] Added a maximum level cap.
[*] Added new treasure chest visuals.
[*] Added consumable item status effect tool tips.
[*] Added a Next/Skip function for dialog lines.
[*] Added more detailed information during fish collection.
[*] Added more tutorials, including additional tutorials for movement and adjustments to existing tutorials for added clarity.
[*] Added new decorations to the world.
[*] Added a new title screen animation.
[*] Added more quality and language settings.
[*] Added a message to alert players that they are deleting their saved game when starting a new game.[/list][h3]Changes and Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Changed the Frame Rate, so the game is locked at 60FPS.
[*] Made adjustments for the block, parry, and defaults for minimum damage.

notes.title: Meet the NPCs 👋 | Epic NPC Man Nice Day for Fishing
notes.content:
[b]Ah! Hello Adventurer and welcome to the Town of Steam News![/b] In November, we were thrilled to see your reception to Epic NPC Man Nice Day for Fishing!

The excited comments regarding our fishing-adventure game set in the Viva La Dirt League world were wonderful to see, and we cannot wait to showcase more of our game soon! 👀

[h2]Meet the NPCs 👋[/h2]
In today's Steam post, we wanted to showcase some of the characters in Nice Day for Fishing and their in-game pixel art character models! 

[h2]🎣 Baelin The Fisherman[/h2]
[h3]Catchphrase: "Morning! Nice day for fishing ain't it? Hua hah!"[/h3]
No surprises here! 😄 As we revealed in our Announcement Trailer, in our fishing adventure game, you'll play as Baelin, the NPC fisherman defending the town of Honeywood the only way he knows how! However, something's different...

As all adventurers of Azerim vanish mysteriously, Baelin must rise to the challenge and become the hero of Honeywood! Play as Baelin, exploring the enchanting lands of Azerim and fighting in epic fishing battles... because, you know, nice day for fishing, ain't it? 🎣

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300978/1188bce12ac58745664ef99cbd64abcd12ba9d7a.png[/img]
[h2]🧄 Greg the Garlic Farmer[/h2]
[h3]Catchphrase: "Ah! Hello Adventurer and welcome to the Town of Honeywood!"[/h3]
Greg The Garlic Farmer, who comes from a long line of garlic farmers, is a character you meet at the beginning of your journey!

Greg runs his shop in the town of Honeywood, which sells garlic and other baits! Baits, like garlic and worms, can be used to catch different types of fish in Epic NPC Man Nice Day for Fishing, so visit Greg's shop to purchase more!

And whilst you're there... let's hope no sheep have run amok! 🐑

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300978/9e704e1297309fec489b283b8d88fde9b91e74a7.png[/img]
[h2]⚒️ Bodger The Blacksmith[/h2]
[h3]Catchphrase: "Ssssccooooooootlaaaaaand!"[/h3]
In the town of Honeywood, you'll find Bodger at his Blacksmith store, likely antagonising Greg the Garlic Farmer! 🤭 Bodger is a talented blacksmith with the training to make such intricate and complicated sets of armour and weapons... which he may mention!

At his Blacksmith store, you can purchase various fishing rods, which feature health and strength stats, to assist you in your defence of Honeywood!

Also, Bodger's grandfather's hammer is missing. Where could it be? 🔨 🤔

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300978/5a4314887a112c9884abd4541dcc70720854bc58.png[/img]
[h3]Character Sound Bites & Reddit Teaser[/h3]
And a lot of questions from our Announcement Trailer have come up around voice acting. We want to clarify that the game is not voice-acted but does contain sound bites from your favourite characters at the beginning of their dialogue!

Over on the Viva La Dirt League subreddit, we linked over two minutes of gameplay in a Reddit teaser. Missed this? [b]Watch the video below that contains the introduction of the game and some of the character sound bites in action![/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uMPj5v_wc_M
[b] Your next quest will begin soon, adventurers![/b] Epic NPC Man Nice Day for Fishing arrives 2025 on Steam. Wishlist today! 👇

notes.title: Nice Day to Announce Epic NPC Man Nice Day for Fishing, ain't it? 😏
notes.content:
Morning! Nice Day for Fishi-Fis- .... Let's try again!

Nice day to announce [b]Epic NPC Man Nice Day for Fishing[/b], ain't it? 😏

Viva La Dirt League, Team17 & FusionPlay have teamed up to bring you the first official game set in Viva La Dirt League’s world of Azerim, Epic NPC Man Nice Day for Fishing! 🎣 Watch our announcement trailer: https://youtu.be/bdB4ybcIfhs

We hope you're excited to explore the Epic NPC Man world in the upcoming Fishing-Adventure RPG! 🐟⚔️
[h2]Key Features[/h2]
[h3]🗺️ Explore the Epic NPC Man world like never before[/h3]
Explore the enchanting lands of Azerim above land and beneath the waves. Adventure through Honeywood Forest to the Azerim coast, where you'll encounter new quests, people to save and new fish to catch.
[h3]💥 Epic RPG fishing battles[/h3]
Engage in fearless fishing battles to increase your strength and unlock spells to use against your aquatic adversaries.
[h3]❗ Ultimate Hero Experience[/h3]
His rod is his weapon; his boat is his steed, and his hat is his armour. Every Adventurer deserves powerful tools for their quest!
[h3]🎣 Complete your fishing collection[/h3]
Prove yourself worthy to the mighty fishing God by offering completed collections from each region at his statue, and receive your blessings of upgraded skills.

Epic NPC Man Nice Day for Fishing arrives 2025 on Steam! Wishlist today 👇
